mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Portsmouth Mental Health Hub
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Local advisers help people find mental health support in Portsmouth. They can explain available services and point you towards community organisations or a referral.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: NHS Talking Therapies Portsmouth
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: An NHS team offering talking therapies for common difficulties such as anxiety, depression and panic. The service was previously called Talking Change.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Kooth
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Online wellbeing support for young people, including counsellor messaging, moderated discussions and self-help tools. Check local access and age eligibility on the site.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: HIVE Portsmouth
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: A local community directory and network connecting Portsmouth residents with voluntary groups, charities and practical support.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Reading Well – Books on Prescription
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Reading lists and self-help books on health and wellbeing. Many titles are available through public libraries.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Mindfulness
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: The guide lists online tools and courses for practising mindfulness. Check the provider for pricing and access requirements.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Solent Mind Community Peer Service
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Local peer support for people experiencing mental health difficulties. The current service outlines the referral pathway through NHS mental health services or the Portsmouth Mental Health Hub.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Wellbeing & Recovery College
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: The successor to Solent Recovery College offers wellbeing education and recovery courses. See the college for its current programme and enrolment routes.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Mind
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Information on mental health, practical support and ways to find help, including services provided by local Mind organisations.

veterans-support.title: Veterans Outreach Support
veterans-support.description: Portsmouth-based wellbeing, welfare and mental health support for members of the armed forces and merchant navy communities, veterans and their families. The organisation can explain how to access its local services.

elderly-support.title: Remind
elderly-support.description: Solent Mind’s Portsmouth service for people living with dementia and their carers. It offers practical support, community activities and help accessing other services.

elderly-support.title: Age UK Portsmouth
elderly-support.description: Local support for people in later life and their carers. Check the Portsmouth branch for available services, activities and advice.

relationship-support.title: Relate
relationship-support.description: Counselling, information and support for people navigating relationship and family difficulties. Visit the provider to explore services and ways to get in touch.

bereavement.title: Cruse Bereavement Support
bereavement.description: Grief information and emotional support after a death. Cruse can help you find local, one-to-one or group support.

bereavement.title: Bereavement support groups
bereavement.description: Find groups and other ways to get support after a loss. Hampshire County Council lists options for different experiences of grief.

citizens-advice.title: Citizens Advice Portsmouth
citizens-advice.description: Free, independent advice on issues such as benefits, debt, housing, employment and consumer rights. Use the Portsmouth listing for local contact options or visit the national site for information.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Portsmouth Abuse and Rape Counselling Service (PARCS)
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Specialist counselling and support for people affected by sexual violence or domestic abuse across Portsmouth and South East Hampshire. The council lists the current contact routes.

contacts.label: Portsmouth City Council: domestic and sexual abuse

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Hampshire domestic abuse support
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Hampshire County Council lists specialist services for people experiencing domestic abuse, those close to them and professionals seeking local support.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Stop Domestic Abuse
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Specialist domestic abuse support for people in Portsmouth and Hampshire. Check the service for local outreach and ways to contact the team.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Aurora New Dawn
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Support and advocacy for people affected by domestic abuse, sexual violence or stalking. The provider lists its services and contact routes.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Yellow Door
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Southampton-based support for people affected by domestic abuse, sexual violence and other interpersonal harm.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Paragon
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Specialist support for people affected by domestic abuse, sexual violence or stalking. Check the provider and police directory for the service covering your area.

contacts.label: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Constabulary: support organisations

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Refuge: National Domestic Abuse Helpline
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Confidential information and specialist support for women experiencing domestic abuse in England.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Men’s Advice Line
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Information and emotional support for men experiencing domestic abuse, and guidance for people supporting them.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Galop
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Support for LGBT+ people affected by abuse or violence, including domestic abuse.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Childline
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Confidential support for children and young people who want to talk about abuse, relationships or other worries.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: Portsmouth Wellbeing Service
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: Local support for stopping smoking, cutting down on alcohol, getting active and managing weight. The service offers help directly and can also receive referrals.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: NHS Better Health: quit smoking
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: Tools and information for people who want to stop smoking, with routes to local support.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: Drug and substance misuse in Portsmouth
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: The council signposts support for people concerned about drug or alcohol use and identifies services for different age groups.

contacts.label: Portsmouth City Council: drug and substance misuse

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: Portsmouth Recovery Hub
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: Local peer-supported recovery and help accessing drug and alcohol services. This is separate from the national FRANK information service.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: FRANK
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: Information about drugs and their effects, with advice and guidance on finding support.

end-of-life-support.title: Macmillan Cancer Support
end-of-life-support.description: Practical, emotional and financial information for people living with cancer and people supporting them.

end-of-life-support.title: Cancer Research UK
end-of-life-support.description: Information about cancer and treatment, including a route to contact specialist information nurses.

end-of-life-support.title: Harbour Cancer Support Centre
end-of-life-support.description: Practical and emotional support in Gosport for people affected by cancer, including relatives, friends and carers.

end-of-life-support.title: Macmillan Information and Support Centre: Queen Alexandra Hospital
end-of-life-support.description: The Portsmouth hospital centre helps people affected by cancer find emotional support, information and practical guidance.

end-of-life-support.title: Macmillan Information Hub: St Richard’s Hospital
end-of-life-support.description: The Chichester hub offers practical information and a place to discuss concerns for people affected by cancer and those close to them.

end-of-life-support.title: Wessex Cancer Support
end-of-life-support.description: Emotional and practical support for people affected by cancer, including family members and carers. Check the directory for current centre locations.

end-of-life-support.title: Dying Matters
end-of-life-support.description: Hospice UK’s programme provides resources for talking about dying, death and grief. Hospice UK also helps people find hospice support.

end-of-life-support.title: Mountbatten Hampshire
end-of-life-support.description: Specialist palliative care and family support in the Southampton area. The hospice was previously known as Countess Mountbatten Hospice.

end-of-life-support.title: Rowans Hospice
end-of-life-support.description: Palliative and hospice support for people with life-limiting illness and those close to them in Portsmouth and South East Hampshire. The access route depends on the service.

end-of-life-support.title: St Wilfrid’s Hospice
end-of-life-support.description: Palliative care in and around Chichester, including hospice care at home and support for families.

end-of-life-support.title: The Rosemary Foundation
end-of-life-support.description: Hospice-at-home nursing and support for people with life-limiting illnesses in and around Petersfield.

paediatrics.title: Hampshire Specialist CAMHS
paediatrics.description: Specialist emotional and mental health services for children and young people. The NHS lists separate contact and referral routes for Hampshire and Portsmouth.

paediatrics.title: Barnardo’s
paediatrics.description: Advice and family support for children, parents and carers. The provider lists services by location; check which programmes currently run in Hampshire.

paediatrics.title: Catch22
paediatrics.description: Programmes for young people and families, including practical and wellbeing support. Check the service finder for current local availability.

paediatrics.title: Hampshire Youth Access
paediatrics.description: Counselling and emotional wellbeing support for children and young people. Its website explains referral rules for Portsmouth and surrounding areas.

paediatrics.title: Relate
paediatrics.description: Young people and families can explore counselling and relationship support through Relate. Ask about local availability.

paediatrics.title: YoungMinds
paediatrics.description: Mental health information and support for young people and practical resources for parents and carers.

paediatrics.title: Simon Says
paediatrics.description: Bereavement support in Hampshire for children and young people facing the death of someone important to them.

paediatrics.title: NHS Talking Therapies Hampshire
paediatrics.description: NHS talking therapies for common mental health difficulties. Use the service site to check whether you are eligible and which local service applies.

paediatrics.title: Childline
paediatrics.description: Children and young people can talk confidentially about worries, including bullying, family problems or abuse.

paediatrics.title: The Mix
paediatrics.description: Digital information and support for young people on issues such as mental health, money and relationships.

paediatrics.title: StayAlive
paediatrics.description: A suicide prevention resource with information and tools such as safety planning. It is not a substitute for urgent professional help.

paediatrics.title: Anxiety UK
paediatrics.description: Information and support for people experiencing anxiety, with resources for young people and those supporting them.

paediatrics.title: Anna Freud
paediatrics.description: Mental health and wellbeing resources for children, young people, families and professionals.

paediatrics.title: No Panic
paediatrics.description: Information and support for people affected by panic attacks, phobias and other anxiety difficulties, including resources for young people.

paediatrics.title: School and college mental health support
paediatrics.description: Ask your school or college about the support available in your setting, including access to a Mental Health Support Team.

contacts.label: Local mental health and wellbeing support

paediatrics.title: Kooth
paediatrics.description: Online wellbeing support and self-help for young people. The site lists current eligibility and access by area.

paediatrics.title: NHS Talking Therapies Portsmouth
paediatrics.description: The Portsmouth service previously known as Talking Change. Its website explains the support it offers and who can use it.

paediatrics.title: Portsmouth CAMHS
paediatrics.description: Specialist mental health support for children and young people registered with a Portsmouth GP. The NHS page describes current eligibility and referral options.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: Urgent mental health help
mental-health-in-crisis.description: For a mental health crisis or emergency in England, the NHS explains how to get urgent help and what to do in an emergency.

contacts.label: NHS: where to get urgent mental health help

mental-health-in-crisis.title: Samaritans
mental-health-in-crisis.description: Confidential listening support for people going through a difficult time.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: Campaign Against Living Miserably (CALM)
mental-health-in-crisis.description: Support and information for people struggling or worried about someone else.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: Shout
mental-health-in-crisis.description: Confidential UK text-based support for people who are struggling to cope. Visit the provider for current instructions.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: StayAlive
mental-health-in-crisis.description: Suicide prevention information and safety-planning tools for people struggling and those supporting them. This resource does not replace urgent care.

other-resources.title: Patient.info
other-resources.description: Health information written for patients, including resources on mental health conditions and wellbeing.

other-resources.title: NHS Every Mind Matters
other-resources.description: Practical NHS wellbeing resources covering topics such as sleep, stress and low mood.

other-resources.title: YoungMinds
other-resources.description: Mental health information and support for young people and parents.

other-resources.title: Anxiety UK
other-resources.description: Information about anxiety and the support the charity offers.

other-resources.title: No Panic
other-resources.description: Self-help information and other support for people experiencing anxiety and panic.

other-resources.title: Calm
other-resources.description: A breathing exercise from the Calm app’s resource library.

other-resources.title: Facing Your Feelings
other-resources.description: A self-help workbook about tolerating emotional distress, from the Centre for Clinical Interventions.

other-resources.title: Psychology Tools
other-resources.description: Information and self-help materials about anxiety. Check the provider for what is freely available.

other-resources.title: Centre for Clinical Interventions
other-resources.description: Self-help workbooks and information sheets from Western Australia’s public mental health service.

other-resources.title: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS videos
other-resources.description: Public videos from the NHS trust that now incorporates former Solent NHS services.
